import base64
from hashlib import sha256
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

ROOT = Path.cwd()
E = ROOT / 'docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-V02/i02-handoff-p2-p3-20261015'
OLD = ROOT / 'docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-V02/i02-handoff-followup-20261015'
AUDIT = Path(r'C:\Users\vladimir\AppData\Local\Temp\ms7-independent-ebuqtjb0')
assert not E.exists()
ENV = {**os.environ, 'GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS': '0'}
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], env=ENV)
def sha(raw):
    return sha256(raw).hexdigest()
def save(path, data):
    path.write_bytes((json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2) + '\n').encode('utf-8'))
assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() == '76d8eac6387a5fde5432a0e8130a881cb6d7ba82'
assert git('branch', '--show-current').decode().strip() == 'ms7-mig-v02-content'
assert not git('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')
changed = git('diff', '--name-only').decode().splitlines()
untracked = git('ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard').decode().splitlines()
assert len(changed) == 5 and len(untracked) == 27
inventory = json.loads((AUDIT / 'independent-inventory.json').read_bytes())
for path, record in inventory['tracked_changes'].items():
    assert sha((ROOT / path).read_bytes()) == record['working_sha256']
old_inventory = json.loads((OLD / 'evidence-inventory.json').read_bytes())
for record in old_inventory['files']:
    assert sha((ROOT / record['path']).read_bytes()) == record['sha256']
all_paths = sorted(set(git('ls-files').decode().splitlines() + untracked))
hashes = {path: sha((ROOT / path).read_bytes()) for path in all_paths}
report = (AUDIT / 'Independent-Audit-Report.md').read_bytes()
old_raw = (OLD / 'raw-command-receipts.json').read_bytes()
old = json.loads(old_raw.decode('utf-8'))
misread = json.loads(old_raw.decode('cp1251'))
analysis = {}
for path, record in old['reproduction_helper_sources'].items():
    raw = (ROOT / path).read_bytes()
    text_raw = record['source_utf8'].encode('utf-8')
    wrong = misread['reproduction_helper_sources'][path]['source_utf8']
    assert sha(raw) == record['sha256'] == sha(text_raw)
    analysis[path] = {'declared_sha256': record['sha256'], 'actual_raw_sha256': sha(raw),
        'actual_utf8_roundtrip_sha256': sha(text_raw), 'raw_size': len(raw),
        'utf8_bom': raw.startswith(b'\xef\xbb\xbf'), 'cr': raw.count(b'\r'), 'lf': raw.count(b'\n'),
        'crlf': raw.count(b'\r\n'), 'raw_valid_utf8': True,
        'cp1251_misread_then_utf8_sha256': sha(wrong.encode('utf-8')),
        'cp1251_misread_recovers_raw_when_reencoded_cp1251': wrong.encode('cp1251') == raw,
        'git_index_entries': git('ls-files', '--stage', '--', path).decode(),
        'git_ignore_rule': git('check-ignore', '-v', path).decode().strip()}
E.mkdir()
save(E / 'intake.json', {'head': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip(),
    'branch': 'ms7-mig-v02-content', 'candidate_tree': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}').decode().strip(),
    'index_sha256': sha(Path(git('rev-parse', '--git-path', 'index').decode().strip()).read_bytes()),
    'modified': changed, 'untracked': untracked, 'snapshot_file_count': len(hashes), 'snapshot_sha256': hashes,
    'prior_diff_sha256': sha(git('diff', '--binary')), 'prior_diff_base64': base64.b64encode(git('diff', '--binary')).decode(),
    'helper_source_pins': {p: r['actual_raw_sha256'] for p, r in analysis.items()},
    'independent_audit_report_path': str(AUDIT / 'Independent-Audit-Report.md'),
    'independent_audit_report_sha256': sha(report), 'independent_audit_report_base64': base64.b64encode(report).decode(),
    'independent_inventory_sha256': sha((AUDIT / 'independent-inventory.json').read_bytes()),
    'original_helper_record_sha256': sha(old_raw),
    'authority': 'User requested scoped P2/P3 remediation; no commit/push/merge permission'})
save(E / 'p3-byte-analysis.json', {'helper_sources': analysis,
    'result': 'Original source and UTF-8 JSON bytes are correct. Reported mismatches reproduced exactly by decoding that same JSON as CP1251.',
    'historical_writer': 'i02_handoff_finalize.py hashes read_bytes and stores raw.decode(); bytes.decode defaults to UTF-8. JSON metadata is UTF-8. No original bytes were corrected.',
    'previous_guard_gap': 'seal verified command-output base64 hashes but never independently round-tripped helper source_utf8.',
    'new_hardening': 'Explicit UTF-8, exact raw source base64 with its own digest, text digest, intake source pins and independent physical-file rereads; no old record/expected hash overwrite.'})
print(json.dumps({'snapshot_files': len(hashes), 'modified': len(changed), 'untracked': len(untracked),
                  'audit_sha256': sha(report), 'all_five_original_utf8_sources_match': True}))

"""New remediation receipts; the previous audit and all prior27 records stay unchanged."""
import base64
from hashlib import sha256
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
import i02_handoff_verify as v
ROOT = v.ROOT
E = ROOT / 'docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-V02/i02-handoff-p2-p3-20261015'
v.E = E
v.ENV['DJANGO_RUNTIME_ROOT'] = str(ROOT / 'var/i02-p2-p3-contract-runtime')
def save(path, data):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_bytes((json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2) + '\n').encode('utf-8'))
v.save = save
PY = v.PY

def sources():
    pins = json.loads((E / 'intake.json').read_bytes())['helper_source_pins']
    records = {}
    for name, expected in pins.items():
        raw = (ROOT / name).read_bytes()
        assert sha256(raw).hexdigest() == expected
        text = raw.decode('utf-8', errors='strict')
        assert text.encode('utf-8') == raw
        records[name] = {'source_encoding': 'utf-8', 'raw_sha256': expected, 'raw_size': len(raw),
            'raw_bytes_base64': base64.b64encode(raw).decode('ascii'), 'source_utf8': text,
            'source_utf8_sha256': sha256(text.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest(),
            'byte_profile': {'bom_utf8': raw.startswith(b'\xef\xbb\xbf'), 'crlf': raw.count(b'\r\n'),
                             'cr': raw.count(b'\r'), 'lf': raw.count(b'\n')}}
    save(E / 'helper-sources-v2.json', {'version': 'i02-helper-source-bytes-v2', 'sources': records,
        'transport_encoding': 'ASCII-escaped JSON, UTF-8/LF; source_utf8 is explicitly re-encoded UTF-8, never locale-decoded',
        'byte_normalization': 'NONE; original source bytes and separate raw/text digests are preserved',
        'approval': 'Integrity record only, not an external R03 anchor'})

if __name__ == '__main__':
    mode = sys.argv[1]
    if mode == 'sources':
        sources()
    elif mode == 'red-p2':
        sys.exit(v.run('before-fix-p2', [PY, '-B', '-m', 'unittest', *[
            'backend.tests.v02.test_http.SQLiteHTTPTests.' + name for name in [
                'test_p2_renderer_top_level_page_mutation_cannot_change_validated_release',
                'test_p2_nested_page_and_context_mutations_preserve_data_and_next_http_request',
                'test_p2_mutating_renderer_failure_is_safe_and_leaves_release_intact']], '-v']))
    elif mode == 'p3':
        sys.exit(v.run('p3-regressions', [PY, '-B', '-m', 'unittest',
            'backend.tests.v02.test_unit.HelperEvidenceIntegrityTests', '-v']))
    elif mode == 'v02':
        sys.exit(v.run('v02-complete', [PY, '-B', '-m', 'unittest', 'backend.tests.v02.test_unit',
            'backend.tests.v02.test_http', 'backend.tests.v02.test_postgres', 'backend.tests.v02.test_asset_regressions', '-v'],
            {'MATHSTART_V02_TEST_ADMIN_URL': 'postgresql+psycopg://postgres:synthetic-local-only@127.0.0.1:15441/postgres'}))
    elif mode == 'baseline':
        sys.exit(v.run('baseline-driver', [PY, '-B', '-m', 'backend.tests.v02.baseline'],
            {'MATHSTART_V02_TEST_ADMIN_URL': 'postgresql+psycopg://postgres:synthetic-local-only@127.0.0.1:15441/postgres'}))
    elif mode == 'r02':
        sys.exit(v.run('r02-contracts', [PY, '-B', '-m', 'unittest', 'discover', '-s', 'tests', '-p', 'test_migration_r02_*.py', '-v']))
    elif mode == 'full-content':
        # Use the unchanged prior helper with only its output-receipt directory
        # redirected in memory. Preserve its physical raw source hash.
        source = (ROOT / 'var/i02_handoff_full_content.py').read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
        source = source.replace('i02-handoff-followup-20261015', 'i02-handoff-p2-p3-20261015')
        code = "__file__=" + repr(str(ROOT / 'var/i02_handoff_full_content.py')) + '\n' + source
        sys.exit(v.run('full-content-loader', [PY, '-B', '-c', code]))
    elif mode == 'command':
        sys.exit(v.run(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3:]))

"""Retain scoped remediation evidence; never stage, publish or rewrite old records."""
import ast
import base64
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from hashlib import sha256
import importlib.metadata
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
E = ROOT / 'docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-V02/i02-handoff-p2-p3-20261015'
INTAKE = json.loads((E / 'intake.json').read_bytes().decode('utf-8'))
ALLOWED = set(INTAKE['modified'])
ENV = {**os.environ, 'GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS': '0', 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE': '1'}
assert not (E / 'verification.json').exists(), 'Refuse to overwrite a final record'

def sha(raw):
    return sha256(raw).hexdigest()

def b64(raw):
    return base64.b64encode(raw).decode('ascii')

def save(name, value):
    (E / name).write_bytes((json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2) + '\n').encode('utf-8'))

def git(*args, data=None):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT, env=ENV, input=data)

def parse_tests(raw):
    text = raw.decode('utf-8', errors='strict')
    return [{'name': m[1], 'result': m[2]} for m in re.findall(
        r'^(test_\w+) \(([\w.]+)\)(?:(?!^test_).)*?\.\.\. (ok|FAIL|ERROR|skipped[^\r\n]*)',
        text, re.MULTILINE | re.DOTALL)]

def preserve():
    assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() == INTAKE['head']
    assert git('branch', '--show-current').decode().strip() == INTAKE['branch']
    assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}').decode().strip() == INTAKE['candidate_tree']
    index = Path(git('rev-parse', '--git-path', 'index').decode().strip())
    assert sha(index.read_bytes()) == INTAKE['index_sha256']
    assert not git('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')
    assert set(git('diff', '--name-only').decode().splitlines()) == ALLOWED
    checked = []
    for name, pin in INTAKE['snapshot_sha256'].items():
        if name not in ALLOWED:
            assert sha((ROOT / name).read_bytes()) == pin, name
            checked.append(name)
    for name, pin in INTAKE['helper_source_pins'].items():
        assert sha((ROOT / name).read_bytes()) == pin, name
    assert sha(Path(INTAKE['independent_audit_report_path']).read_bytes()) == INTAKE['independent_audit_report_sha256']
    assert sha(base64.b64decode(INTAKE['independent_audit_report_base64'], validate=True)) == INTAKE['independent_audit_report_sha256']
    new_paths = git('ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard').decode().splitlines()
    assert set(INTAKE['untracked']) <= set(new_paths)
    assert all(p in INTAKE['untracked'] or p.startswith(E.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() + '/') for p in new_paths)
    assert sha((ROOT / 'backend/content/releases.py').read_bytes()) == INTAKE['snapshot_sha256']['backend/content/releases.py']
    return {'protected_files_checked': len(checked), 'other_tracked_files': len(checked) - len(INTAKE['untracked']),
        'previous_evidence_files': len(INTAKE['untracked']), 'all_unchanged': True,
        'original_helpers_unchanged': len(INTAKE['helper_source_pins']), 'independent_negative_audit_unchanged': True,
        'raw_index_sha256': sha(index.read_bytes()), 'head_unchanged': True, 'index_unchanged': True,
        'staged_changes': 0, 'tracked_modified': sorted(ALLOWED), 'home_context_production_unchanged_since_intake': True,
        'boundaries': {'frozen_R02_R02A_R03A': 'UNCHANGED', 'V01_Alembic': 'UNCHANGED',
            'frontend_Django_V04': 'UNCHANGED', 'root_CI_R03': 'UNCHANGED',
            'historical_evidence_policy_manifests_approval_pins': 'UNCHANGED'}}

preservation = preserve()
commands, receipts = [], {}
for path in sorted(E.glob('*.json')):
    record = json.loads(path.read_bytes().decode('utf-8'))
    if 'label' not in record:
        continue
    label = record['label']
    assert label == path.stem
    stdout = (E / (label + '.stdout.log')).read_bytes()
    stderr = (E / (label + '.stderr.log')).read_bytes()
    assert sha(stdout) == record['stdout_sha256'] and sha(stderr) == record['stderr_sha256']
    named = parse_tests(stdout + b'\n' + stderr)
    record['named_tests'] = named
    record['actual_counts'] = dict(Counter(t['result'] for t in named))
    if label == 'before-fix-p2':
        assert record['exit_code'] == 1 and record['test_count'] == 3
        assert record['actual_counts'] == {'FAIL': 3}
        record['classification'] = 'EXPECTED_FAIL: three HTTP regressions reproduce original mutable page defect'
    elif label == 'after-fix-p2':
        assert record['exit_code'] == 1 and b'IndentationError' in stderr
        record['classification'] = 'RESOLVED task-introduced indentation error during patch authoring; no tests executed'
    elif label == 'v02-final':
        assert record['exit_code'] == 0 and len([t for t in named if t['result'].startswith('skipped')]) == 50
        record['classification'] = 'INCOMPLETE_COVERAGE: additional run omitted PG URL; 68 PASS/50 SKIP, replaced by final explicit-PG run'
    else:
        assert record['exit_code'] == 0, record
        record['classification'] = 'PASS'
    record['raw_receipt_key'] = label
    receipts[label] = {'stdout_base64': b64(stdout), 'stderr_base64': b64(stderr),
        'stdout_sha256': sha(stdout), 'stderr_sha256': sha(stderr)}
    commands.append(record)
    save(path.name, record)

driver = next(r for r in receipts if r == 'baseline-driver')
rows = [json.loads(line) for line in base64.b64decode(receipts[driver]['stdout_base64']).decode('utf-8').splitlines() if line.startswith('{')]
runtime = Path(rows[0]['log']).parent
baseline = json.loads((runtime / 'results.json').read_bytes().decode('utf-8'))
assert baseline['disposable'] and len(baseline['commands']) == 5
for label, result in zip(['fresh-install-smoke', 'verify-repo', 'baseline-version-report', 'r02a', 'r03a'], baseline['commands']):
    raw = Path(result['log']).read_bytes()
    assert result['exit_code'] == 0
    counts = [int(n) for n in re.findall(rb'Ran (\d+) tests? in', raw)]
    if label == 'verify-repo':
        assert b'RESULT: PASS (8 checks passed).' in raw
        assert counts == [109, 18, 73], counts
        assert not re.search(rb'OK \(skipped=', raw)
    if label in {'r02a', 'r03a'}:
        assert counts == ([30] if label == 'r02a' else [41])
    receipts[label] = {'combined_base64': b64(raw), 'combined_sha256': sha(raw)}
    commands.append({'label': label, 'exit_code': result['exit_code'], 'argv': result['argv'],
        'suite_test_counts': counts, 'named_tests': parse_tests(raw), 'raw_receipt_key': label,
        'classification': 'PASS', 'source_log': result['log'], 'combined_sha256': sha(raw)})

final_suites = {'v02-final-with-pg': 118, 'v01-complete': 34, 'r02-contracts': 63, 'r02a': 30, 'r03a': 41}
matrix = []
for label, count in final_suites.items():
    record = next(r for r in commands if r['label'] == label)
    assert len(record['named_tests']) == count, (label, len(record['named_tests']))
    assert all(t['result'] == 'ok' for t in record['named_tests']), label
    matrix.extend({'suite': label, **t} for t in record['named_tests'])
pg = [t for t in matrix if t['suite'] == 'v02-final-with-pg' and 'PostgreSQL' in t['name']]
assert len(pg) == 50, len(pg)
prior_methods = set(re.findall(rb'^\+    def (test_\w+)\(', base64.b64decode(INTAKE['prior_diff_base64']), re.MULTILINE))
def methods(raw):
    return {item.name.encode() for node in ast.parse(raw).body if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef)
        for item in node.body if isinstance(item, ast.FunctionDef) and item.name.startswith('test_')}
all_added = set()
for name in ['backend/tests/v02/test_unit.py', 'backend/tests/v02/test_http.py']:
    all_added |= methods((ROOT / name).read_bytes()) - methods(git('show', INTAKE['head'] + ':' + name))
remediation_methods = all_added - prior_methods
assert len(remediation_methods) == 7
new_executions = [t for t in matrix if t['suite'] == 'v02-final-with-pg' and t['name'].split('.')[-1].encode() in remediation_methods]
assert len(new_executions) == 10
save('test-inventory.json', {'final_suites': final_suites, 'v02_postgresql': len(pg), 'final_suite_failures': 0,
    'final_suite_skips': 0, 'p2_p3_new_methods': sorted(n.decode() for n in remediation_methods),
    'p2_p3_executions': new_executions, 'all_named_target_and_contract_tests': matrix,
    'verify_repo_checks': 8, 'verify_repo_nested_counts': [109, 18, 73], 'verify_repo_skips': 0,
    'intermediate_attempts': 'See verification/raw receipts: expected red3, resolved syntax error, omitted-PG run68PASS/50SKIP are retained'})

full = json.loads(base64.b64decode(receipts['full-content-loader']['stdout_base64']).decode('utf-8').splitlines()[-1])
assert full['pages'] == 279 and full['topics'] == 263 and full['full_profile_loader'] == 'PASS'
smoke = json.loads(base64.b64decode(receipts['runtime-no-django']['stdout_base64']).decode('utf-8'))
assert len(smoke['http_smoke']) == 8 and not smoke['django_installed'] and not smoke['django_imported']

# Old helpers and old raw evidence stay untouched. Archive only new tooling here.
tool_sources = {}
for name in ['var/i02_p2_p3_intake.py', 'var/i02_p2_p3_verify.py', 'var/i02_p2_p3_finalize.py']:
    raw = (ROOT / name).read_bytes()
    text = raw.decode('utf-8', errors='strict')
    assert text.encode('utf-8') == raw
    tool_sources[name] = {'source_encoding': 'utf-8', 'raw_bytes_base64': b64(raw), 'raw_sha256': sha(raw),
        'raw_size': len(raw), 'source_utf8': text, 'source_utf8_sha256': sha(text.encode('utf-8'))}
save('reproduction-tools.json', {'sources': tool_sources, 'normalization': 'NONE',
    'note': 'Historical five helper sources are separately retained in helper-sources-v2.json with unchanged intake pins'})
save('raw-command-receipts.json', {'encoding': 'Exact raw stdout/stderr or combined bytes as base64; NO normalization',
    'receipts': receipts, 'baseline_results': baseline})
for label, receipt in receipts.items():
    for suffix, key in [('.stdout.log', 'stdout_base64'), ('.stderr.log', 'stderr_base64')]:
        path = E / (label + suffix)
        if path.exists():
            assert path.parent.resolve() == E.resolve()
            assert path.read_bytes() == base64.b64decode(receipt[key], validate=True)
            path.unlink()

files = {}
for name in sorted(ALLOWED):
    raw = (ROOT / name).read_bytes()
    cleaned = raw.replace(b'\r\n', b'\n')
    oid = git('hash-object', '--path=' + name, '--stdin', data=raw).decode().strip()
    from hashlib import sha1
    assert sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(cleaned)).encode() + b'\0' + cleaned).hexdigest() == oid
    files[name] = {'intake_working_sha256': INTAKE['snapshot_sha256'][name], 'working_sha256': sha(raw),
        'working_size': len(raw), 'prospective_blob_sha256': sha(cleaned), 'prospective_blob_oid': oid,
        'mode': git('ls-files', '--stage', '--', name).decode().split()[0], 'staged': False,
        'attributes': git('check-attr', '-a', '--', name).decode().splitlines(),
        'baseline_blob_oid': git('rev-parse', INTAKE['head'] + ':' + name).decode().strip()}
save('changed-bytes.json', {'files': files, 'object_write_or_index_update': False,
    'remediation_changed_since_intake': [name for name, r in files.items() if r['intake_working_sha256'] != r['working_sha256']],
    'note': 'Read-only prospective clean-filter OID; working bytes have their own separate digests'})
diff = git('diff', '--binary', '--no-ext-diff', '--', *sorted(ALLOWED))
save('source-diff.json', {'parent_candidate_sha': INTAKE['head'], 'diff_sha256': sha(diff), 'diff_base64': b64(diff),
    'numstat': git('diff', '--numstat').decode(), 'prior_diff_sha256': INTAKE['prior_diff_sha256']})
whitespace = []
for label, args in [('worktree-ordinary', ['diff', '--check']),
    ('worktree-cr-at-eol', ['-c', 'core.whitespace=cr-at-eol', 'diff', '--check']),
    ('cached-ordinary', ['diff', '--cached', '--check']),
    ('cached-cr-at-eol', ['-c', 'core.whitespace=cr-at-eol', 'diff', '--cached', '--check'])]:
    p = subprocess.run(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT, env=ENV, capture_output=True)
    assert p.returncode == 0 and not p.stdout and not p.stderr
    whitespace.append({'label': label, 'argv': ['git', *args], 'exit_code': p.returncode,
        'stdout_base64': b64(p.stdout), 'stderr_base64': b64(p.stderr)})
save('whitespace.json', {'checks': whitespace, 'scope': 'Current follow-up diff against HEAD; original publication FAIL/2 and approved40path policy are preserved history'})
save('preservation.json', preserve())
versions = {'python': sys.version, 'executable': sys.executable,
    'packages': {name: importlib.metadata.version(name) for name in ['Django', 'fastapi', 'starlette', 'SQLAlchemy', 'psycopg', 'alembic', 'jsonschema']},
    **{label: base64.b64decode(receipts[label]['stdout_base64']).decode('utf-8').strip()
       for label in ['docker-version', 'linux-python-version', 'postgres-version']}}
record = {'recommendation': 'READY FOR INDEPENDENT RE-AUDIT', 'recorded_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'parent_candidate_sha': INTAKE['head'], 'tested_implementation_sha': None, 'HEAD': 'unchanged',
    'commit_push_merge_rebase_PR_update': 'NOT PERFORMED', 'P2_mutable_page': 'LOCALLY_FIXED', 'P3_source_utf8': 'LOCALLY_FIXED',
    'independent_audit_original_verdict': 'CHANGES REQUIRED; preserved, not superseded by local approval',
    'P3_reconciliation': 'Both original source_utf8 values match declared raw SHA when JSON is decoded UTF-8. Both reported mismatch hashes reproduce exactly through CP1251 misread. Actual auditor command responsible is unproven. Explicit encoding/raw-byte verification added without changing old bytes/pins.',
    'tests': {'V02': '118 PASS / 0 FAIL / 0 SKIP', 'V02_PG': 50, 'V01': 34, 'R02': 63, 'R02A': 30, 'R03A': 41,
        'verify_repo': '8/8 PASS', 'verify_repo_nested': [109, 18, 73], 'Content': '279/263 PASS',
        'runtime_without_Django': '8 localhost HTTP cases PASS', 'P2_before': '3 FAIL, exit1', 'P2_after': '3 PASS, exit0',
